description:
Predeclare and execute the argmin calibration protocol for the twelve extent fields under crate-owned tuning sections.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design at `dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md` fixes the extent-field set and explains why the standing crossover rule does not apply. Eleven extent fields belong to `gf2-core`; `permanent.gray_chunk_subsets` belongs to `gf2-algebra`. The crate-owned tuning design at `dev/active/3fa7c9d0/design.md` governs the two owner codecs, strict owner envelopes, fresh-process steering, and mechanical complete-envelope composition.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed predeclaration fixes, before measurement, each extent field's operand sizes, parameter grid, repetitions/stopping rule, argmin selection, tie handling, non-monotonicity handling, fallback, receipt schema, and deterministic seed/stream allocation.
- [hard] REQ-02: The explicit benchmark action implements the protocol for all twelve extents: eleven core fields through `CoreTuningCodec` and `permanent.gray_chunk_subsets` only through the algebra-owned `AlgebraTuningCodec` and `gf2-algebra/permanent` section. Core never owns or serializes the permanent selector. Every timed route runs in a fresh child that installs the required strict owner or complete envelope and proves `Installed` resolution for every affecting section. The parents and composer never install; a nonzero exit, malformed result, `DefaultedMissing`, or `FrozenBeforeInstall` invalidates the run without publishing an artifact.
- [hard] REQ-03: The receipt records full grids, timing samples and uncertainty, route observations, argmin selection and fallback, ties, non-monotone cases, contradictory evidence, clean source revision, seed, host, toolchain, and separate section-measurement versus envelope-assembly provenance. An unswept or invalid field remains omitted when the predeclared protocol justifies no measured claim. The committed receipt carries these records directly or as summaries (per-arm sample counts, medians, spreads) with digest citations; raw timing windows, accepted results, checkpoints and the execution log are host-local archived evidence, pinned by SHA-256 through the committed checksum manifest and not committed to the repository (invoker decision 2026-09-30, repository size).
- [hard] REQ-04: The run atomically updates and strictly reopens authoritative core-owner and algebra-owner format-2 envelopes. Each owner's single section-level measurement provenance and receipt cover every retained measured selector in that section; values not covered by the run are explicitly superseded or omitted. The both-codec composer emits and strictly reopens the complete repository envelope with exact canonical wrapper identity for both owners.
- [hard] REQ-05: One outer benchmark lock covers calibration and composition; no inner component locks, build side effects, reverse production dependency, partial-composite loader, or duplicate tuning authority are introduced.
